document.headline: Senior Mobile Engineer | iOS lead in regulated sectors
professional_summary: **Lead iOS engineer for regulated apps:** leads the retail banking app at Brightwater Bank, with 1.2M monthly users.
**Release automation:** moved two apps to weekly releases with Fastlane and GitHub Actions, cutting build time by 40%.
**Accessibility first:** led a WCAG 2.2 AA audit, with VoiceOver journeys covered by UI tests.
**Health sector delivery:** shipped video consultations for a 40-clinic patient app in six weeks.

items: **Swift and SwiftUI:** daily on the banking app; migrated legacy Objective-C screens to Swift at Harbour Health.
**Regulated sectors:** four years in health and four in banking.
**CI/CD:** Fastlane and GitHub Actions pipeline behind weekly releases.
**Accessibility:** WCAG 2.2 AA audit lead; author of an accessible SwiftUI charts library.

education_credentials: BSc (Hons) Computer Science, University of the West of England
